gpuWarmup.sourceContract: Kaisen scene.prepare initial GPU wait accepts pending/stalled until a real ready fence; source runtime render queue stalls at 1 s.
gpuWarmup.adaptation: All hidden shared material variants, instanced normal buffers and aircraft/non-aircraft line buffers are warmed by a 16x16 loading draw. Warm points follow the current camera during initial preparation and context recovery. The initialization wait is bounded to 30 s; Main gates Start separately on a full-size Home frame fence. Identical stopped scenes poll their existing fence without repeated GPU submissions. Runtime strict 1 s stall threshold is unchanged; an unfinished fence is not reset on retry.
gpuWarmup.sourceComparison: Independent verification measured fixed Kaisen graphicsReady at 9.17 s and initial stalled around 3.9-8.7 s on the same software GPU. This is not iPhone frame-time evidence.
